manual_interventions.description: All 7 SQL statements required manual conversion due to DMS statement_conversion_tool failure
manual_interventions.reason: DMS metadata model creation failed with 'Unknown metadata model creation status: RECEIVED'
manual_interventions.approach: Used DMS schema_mapping_tool (which worked) to get correct target schema/table/column names, then manually converted SQL syntax

manual_interventions.description: Statements 3, 4, 5 required C# code restructuring beyond SQL conversion
manual_interventions.reason: Original code used embedded T-SQL transactions with DECLARE/SET variables which don't translate directly to PostgreSQL parameterized queries via Npgsql
manual_interventions.approach: Split single multi-statement SQL into separate NpgsqlCommand instances within C# managed transactions (BeginTransactionAsync/CommitAsync/RollbackAsync)

manual_interventions.description: Package version changed from plan specification (8.0.1) to 9.0.3
manual_interventions.reason: Npgsql 8.0.1 has known high severity vulnerability GHSA-x9vc-6hfv-hg8c. Per guardrail rules, insecure dependencies are not allowed.
manual_interventions.approach: Used Npgsql 9.0.3 which is the latest stable version compatible with .NET 9.0 without known vulnerabilities
